method.vintage_history: ALFRED observations output_type=3 new/revised events only
method.date_alignment: native observation dates; no resampling or interpolation
method.missing_values: preserved as null with source_missing_value status

series.label: CBOE VIX
series.source: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis FRED/ALFRED
series.note: VIX methodology changed in 2003; treat the pre/post-2003 history as a structural-break-aware series.

series.label: Chicago Fed National Financial Conditions Index
series.source: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis FRED/ALFRED
series.note: Positive values indicate tighter-than-average financial conditions; negative values indicate looser-than-average conditions.

series.label: NFCI Credit Subindex
series.source: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis FRED/ALFRED
series.note: A component of NFCI, not an independent standalone credit index; do not double-count it as an independent measure.

series.label: St. Louis Fed Financial Stress Index
series.source: Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis FRED/ALFRED
series.note: Positive values indicate above-average financial stress; negative values indicate below-average financial stress.
